billing.title: Organization subscription
billing.subtitle: One price per member tier, no commitment. The free tier is the trial.
billing.precontractual: Open-ended subscription, prices include VAT, renewed automatically at each term until cancelled. Cancel any time from this screen, no reason or fee required.
billing.withdrawalImmediate: I ask for the subscription to start immediately, without waiting for the 14-day withdrawal period.
billing.withdrawalWaiver: I acknowledge that by starting immediately, I waive my 14-day right of withdrawal once the service has been fully supplied.
billing.withdrawalHint: Both confirmations are required to continue.
billing.intervalYearlyHint: Charged once a year, 30% less than the monthly price. The seat count is identical.
billing.statusPastDue: The last payment failed. Current members keep full access, but no new member can be added until payment is settled.
billing.statusCancelled: Subscription cancelled. Current members keep full access; the seat quota is back to the free tier.
billing.manageHint: Payment method, invoices, tier changes and cancellation are handled on Stripe.
billing.ownerOnly: Billing is managed by the organization owner.
billing.dormant: Enterprise billing is not active yet. Everything is free for now.
billing.alreadySubscribed: This organization already has an active subscription. Use "Manage subscription" to change tier.
billing.yearlyUnavailable: Yearly billing is not available yet. Monthly payment does work, and the grid has just switched back to it.
billing.error: Could not reach Stripe. Please try again shortly.
billing.withdrawalRequired: Payment requires both withdrawal-waiver boxes to be ticked.
billing.refundDone: Subscription cancelled, €{{amount}} refunded. The transfer appears within 5 to 10 business days depending on your bank.
billing.cancelDone: Subscription cancelled. There was nothing to refund for the current period.
billing.noSubscription: This company has no active subscription.
billing.refundFailed: The refund did not go through. Nothing was cancelled, try again in a moment.
billing.refundExplain: You get the current period back, with no reason to give and no need to write to us. Access stops immediately, since the period is refunded.
billing.refundCta: Cancel and refund the current period
billing.currentTierFree: You are on the free tier.
